fields.System.Title: EPIC INT — Integration and Reporting
fields.System.Description:
Goal

The WMS and the ERP agree with each other, the slow questions are answerable quickly, and data
problems are found by a report rather than by a customer.

Business value

The WMS does not run in isolation. Orders come from somewhere and invoices are raised
somewhere else. Every message lost or duplicated between the two becomes a stock discrepancy
or a billing error, and both are discovered late.

The reporting half of this epic is cheap to build and pays for itself within weeks. Data
quality reports in particular find master data problems before they become inventory
problems.

Scope

In. Inbound ERP messages — ASNs, orders, master data. Outbound confirmations — receipts,
shipments, adjustments. Retry, dead-letter, and deduplication. Projections with rebuild and
reconciliation jobs. Operational reports. Data quality reports.

Out. The ERP itself. Business intelligence tooling and dashboards beyond simple
operational views. Financial reporting.

Done when

  • ERP messages are validated at the edge and rejected with a clear reason.
  • A replayed ERP message creates one record, not two.
  • Malformed messages land in a dead-letter store that someone reviews daily.
  • Outbound events survive the ERP being switched off for an hour.
  • Every projection has a rebuild job and a reconciliation job.
  • Data quality reports run weekly and produce an actionable list.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| ERP retry creates a duplicate order | Double shipment | [doc 09 §3.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Malformed message dropped silently | ERP believes in orders the WMS never saw | [doc 08 §6](../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
| Event lost after commit | Downstream diverges with no signal | [doc 09 §2.4](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Projection drifts from source | Wrong availability shown; over-promising | [doc 09 §12](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Projection used for allocation | The same unit sold twice | [doc 09 §12](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| No rebuild job | Cannot recover from drift during an incident | [doc 08 §3](../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
| WMS and ERP stock drift | Discovered at year end, unattributable | [doc 08 §6](../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
